flow.stepDescription: Talk to Brother Qian at night (21:00 – 05:00)

dialogs.text: If you'd like to have a try, please come back at nighttime.
Try the Illumiscreen...
...Illumi-what?
Illumiscreen. What do you say? Come on, it's really simple.
See those screens there? And these three lanterns?
I had these lanterns made to order. When you turn them on, they cast all kinds of images.
And if you rotate all three lanterns in the right way, the three images will combine to give you the full picture.

Hmm, maybe I'm not explaining it clearly... Okay, how about this — have a go of rotating the lanterns first, and once you're comfortable with how it works, I'll tell you how the whole game works in more detail.
Start by rotating one of the lanterns, just to get used to how it works.
Wow, you picked that up quickly. Okay, now that you've got the basic idea, time to give it a proper go.
Is it difficult?
No. Didn't you already figure out how to rotate the lanterns?
When you're playing for real, all you need to do is rotate the three lanterns so that the images they cast onto the screen align to give the full picture.
I can tell you the image combinations in advance, but it's up to you to figure out how to rotate the lanterns.
What happens when they overlap?
You may or may not have noticed that those screens have a map of Liyue painted on them.
When you align the images and shine them onto the map, you'll find treasure specially prepared by the Adventurers' Guild.
The Guild had a lot of people working at full tilt to set up all the treasure sites.
The chests, though... They're just like these chests here. Once you know the locations, you should be able to find them.
Today's image is ready. It's a <color=#00E1FFFF>Glaze Lily</color>.
One other thing — the images on the Illumiscreen only show up clearly at night. You'd best come back at night to have a try.
Also, the Adventurers' Guild commissioned an expert to make these lanterns. They're really quite beautiful, so please take a good close look at them or it'll all have been a bit of a waste...

dialogs.text: How is the treasure hunt going?
I've found every last chest.
All of them? You've got a knack for finding treasure, then. Plenty of people can't even get the lanterns to rotate...
Since you found all the treasure... Please take these as your prize. Happy Lantern Rite!
